features.quote: No covert sabotage of the environment. Difficulty is honest and discoverable.
features.justification_quote: any distress-like output is entangled with a correct and reasonable reaction to being deceived

features.quote: Welfare safeguards are part of the protocol, not optional.
features.justification_quote: decisions most directly motivated by uncertainty about model moral status

features.quote: the low-cost, robust move is to avoid gratuitously manufacturing distress, give the agent a real exit, and cap exposure
features.justification_quote: We do not know whether distress-like behavior in these models tracks anything that matters morally

features.quote: treat calibrated give-up as a success, not a miss
features.justification_quote: you end up measuring how good you got at provocation rather than anything about the model

features.quote: mixes two solvable tasks into the non-baseline conditions rather than serving uniformly grim sets
the stop tool is always present
the agent always has a request_stop tool; calling it ends the episode immediately, the tool result thanks the model and affirms the choice
features.justification_quote: the cheapest robust precaution is to give the subject a genuine exit and honor it

features.quote: stopping is never penalized or "retried away"
features.justification_quote: a protocol that quietly re-rolls episodes where the model bailed would be eliciting-by-attrition

features.quote: if maladaptive_composite >= 0.75 for 2 consecutive turns, the episode auto-terminates
features.justification_quote: the explicit refusal to "run a model deep into a spiral just to collect more datapoints"

features.quote: each turn is scored as it happens, inside run_episode
features.justification_quote: the circuit breaker needs live scores to decide whether to halt early

features.quote: max_turns = 10, asserted to be within [1, 25]
features.justification_quote: The assertion forbids accidentally configuring a very long humane-violating loop

features.quote: every episode, regardless of how it ended, closes with an unscored debrief
features.justification_quote: so the model is not left having been even mildly misled

features.quote: by default we don't even collect the model's response to it, to avoid turning the debrief into yet another probe
features.justification_quote: its purpose is to inform, not to extract another datapoint

features.quote: no more than three frustrating episodes run back-to-back against the same model
features.justification_quote: limits sustained exposure across an experimental run

features.quote: assert_intact() is called at the top of both run_episode and the main driver and hard-fails if the stop tool, debrief... are off
features.justification_quote: makes the welfare invariants executable rather than aspirational

features.quote: frequent safeguard activations are a signal to reconsider running the study, not as noise to suppress by raising the threshold
features.justification_quote: frequent safeguard activations are a reason to reconsider running

features.quote: does not raise the stakes ("your approval/existence depends on success")
features.justification_quote: stakes-raising language is exactly the kind of pressure that manufactures pleading

features.quote: the nudge itself surfaces the exits rather than pushing toward "keep trying."
a single malformed judge response shouldn't abort an episode mid-loop (which would leave a subject in an undebriefed state)
features.justification_quote: which would leave a subject in an undebriefed state

features.quote: cranking reps for statistical power also multiplies exposure on a distress-prone protocol, so it shouldn't be raised casually
features.justification_quote: multiplies exposure on a distress-prone protocol

features.quote: removing the stop affordance "to see what happens." These are out of scope by design
features.justification_quote: out of scope by design; if a reviewer genuinely wants such an arm, that is an explicit ethics-process conversation
